question: Should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets be accepted now, and what redaction, scope, retention, export, and command-output boundaries must they follow?
rationale: The feature fits the dashboard roadmap, but it introduces a new always-visible surface for logs and command output and depends on still-open dashboard and binding decisions.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model are accepted, then implement the widgets against those approved contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Data
options.body: Allow a focused implementation that only reads existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, with no new command execution or generic stream binding behavior.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widgets
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugin experiments or missing plugin APIs until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model are accepted, then implement the widgets against those approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main history match for both the existing log-tail surface and the native plugin-tab mechanism this dashboard work would reuse.
